measurements.name: 06_cross_app_group_top_25

sqlite: SCAN p USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_Person_1
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
substrate:
Sort: sum(d.amount) DESC NULLS LAST, p.id ASC NULLS FIRST, fetch=25
  Projection: p.id, count(Int64(1)) AS count(*), sum(w.durationMinutes), sum(d.amount)
    Aggregate: groupBy=[[p.id]], aggr=[[count(Int64(1)), sum(CAST(CAST(w.durationMinutes AS Int64) AS Int64)), sum(CAST(CAST(d.amount AS Int64) AS Int64))]]
      Projection: p.id, w.durationMinutes, d.amount
        Inner Join: c.deal = d.id
          Projection: p.id, w.durationMinutes, c.deal
            Inner Join: p.id = c.customer
              Projection: p.id, w.durationMinutes
                Inner Join: f.workout = w.id
                  Projection: p.id, f.workout
                    Inner Join: p.id = f.athlete
                      SubqueryAlias: p
                        TableScan: core.Person projection=[id]
                      SubqueryAlias: f
                        TableScan: fitness.Performed projection=[athlete, workout]
                  SubqueryAlias: w
                    TableScan: fitness.Workout projection=[id, durationMinutes]
              SubqueryAlias: c
                TableScan: crm.CustomerDeal projection=[customer, deal]
          SubqueryAlias: d
            TableScan: crm.Deal projection=[id, amount]

ProjectionExec: expr=[id@0 as id, count(Int64(1))@1 as count(*), sum(w.durationMinutes)@2 as sum(w.durationMinutes), sum(d.amount)@3 as sum(d.amount)]
  SortExec: TopK(fetch=25), expr=[sum(d.amount)@3 DESC NULLS LAST, id@0 ASC], preserve_partitioning=[false]
    AggregateExec: mode=Single, gby=[id@0 as id], aggr=[count(Int64(1)), sum(w.durationMinutes), sum(d.amount)]
      HashJoinExec: mode=CollectLeft, join_type=Inner, on=[(deal@2, id@0)], projection=[id@0, durationMinutes@1, amount@4]
        HashJoinExec: mode=CollectLeft, join_type=Inner, on=[(id@0, customer@0)], projection=[id@0, durationMinutes@1, deal@3]
          HashJoinExec: mode=CollectLeft, join_type=Inner, on=[(workout@1, id@0)], projection=[id@0, durationMinutes@3]
            HashJoinExec: mode=CollectLeft, join_type=Inner, on=[(id@0, athlete@0)], projection=[id@0, workout@2]
              DataSourceExec: partitions=1, partition_sizes=[2]
              DataSourceExec: partitions=1, partition_sizes=[4]
            DataSourceExec: partitions=1, partition_sizes=[4]
          DataSourceExec: partitions=1, partition_sizes=[4]
        DataSourceExec: partitions=1, partition_sizes=[4]

measurements.sql: SELECT person_id,link_id,workout_id,minutes FROM (SELECT p.id AS person_id,f.id AS link_id,w.id AS workout_id,w."durationMinutes" AS minutes,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY w."durationMinutes" DESC,f.id) AS rn FROM core."Person" p JOIN fitness."Performed" f ON f.athlete=p.id JOIN fitness."Workout" w ON w.id=f.workout WHERE w."durationMinutes">=30) ranked WHERE rn<=1 ORDER BY person_id LIMIT 100
